dev: Run commands and checks in a Yoke source checkout.
dev db-admin: Set up and use admin access to a database.
dev db-admin exec: Run a command with an admin database address set.
dev db-admin setup: Plan or save a local admin database profile.
dev import-check: Check that Python modules import in a source lane.
dev ruff-changed: Lint the Python files changed since a base commit.
dev run: Run a command in a source lane's locked environment.
dev setup: Set up this machine to develop Yoke from source.
dev yokepedia: Build Yokepedia from this source checkout and open it.
